audience: Amazon sellers who reprice their listings with Repricer.com

useCases.title: Request an inventory report and download it when ready
useCases.text: Ask Repricer for an inventory report and check its progress. Download the CSV once the report is listed as ready.

useCases.title: Find products that sit at their minimum price
useCases.text: List the ready reports and download an inventory report as CSV. Then list the rows priced at their minimum.

useCases.title: Find SKUs with no minimum price
useCases.text: Export the repricer file as CSV with every listing. Use a report instead for accounts above 25,000 SKUs.

useCases.title: Regenerate a report every 8 hours
useCases.text: Set a report schedule, such as every 8 hours. Each new run overwrites the last report. Set the schedule to NEVER to remove it.

useCases.title: Import an approved repricer file
useCases.text: Export the current repricer file first. Import the CSV only after you approve that exact file in the chat. The import can change live prices.
